const NATIVE_BINDING_TYPES
const NATIVE_OPERATIONS
enum Proof
  NONE = 'none'
  CLAIMED = 'claimed'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  UNSIGNED = 'unsigned'
  UNMET = 'unmet'
  PID = 'pid'
  BOUND = 'bound'
  KERNEL = 'kernel'
  SIGNED = 'signed'
dataclass ProofFailure
  attribute: str
  have: Proof | None
  need: Proof | None
  why: str
dataclass ProofRequirement
  user: Proof | None
  process: Proof | None
  path: Proof | None
  package: Proof | None
  code: Proof | None
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
def decode(data)
def encode(v)
